steps.en: The selected batch number is displayed
steps.why_en: No screen shows a court application batch number.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar yang menampilkan batch number court application.

steps.en: A summary by ID type and notice type is displayed
steps.id: Ringkasan per tipe ID dan tipe notice ditampilkan
steps.why_en: The court report entries are empty placeholders with no data behind them.
steps.why_id: Entri laporan court hanya placeholder kosong tanpa data di baliknya.

steps.en: Court number, division and mention time are pre-filled
steps.id: Nomor court, division, dan waktu mention terisi otomatis
steps.why_en: No logic fills these fields; only data types exist in the screen code.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada logic yang mengisi field ini; hanya ada tipe data di code layar.

steps.en: Officer can edit those fields before submitting
steps.id: Petugas bisa mengedit field itu sebelum mengajukan
steps.why_en: No form exists to edit court application fields.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada form untuk mengedit field court application.
